validation.label: Random k-fold
validation.description: Does not separate dependent groups; for such data, choose the grouped method.
validation.cost: Increases with data size and number of folds.

validation.label: Repeated random k-fold
validation.description: Each repeat is evaluated separately; the number of predictions is not the number of independent samples.
validation.cost: Increases with data size and number of folds.

validation.label: Grouped k-fold
validation.description: Observations linked by profile, parcel and farm relationships are kept together.
validation.cost: Increases with data size and number of folds.

validation.label: Spatial block
validation.description: Metric grid blocks are assigned to folds. This is not an unbiased estimate of map accuracy.
validation.cost: Increases with data size and number of folds.

validation.label: Buffered spatial
validation.description: Training groups closer to the test blocks than the buffer distance are removed.
validation.cost: Increases with data size and number of folds.

validation.label: User-defined folds
validation.description: ID coverage, group and distance conditions are still checked.
validation.cost: Increases with data size and number of folds.

validation.label: k-fold nearest neighbor distance matching (kNNDM)
validation.description: Distance matching with local CAST 1.0.4. This version supports only unique independent observations, metric coordinates and at most 2000 training points.

maxp.label: Maximum fraction of observations in one fold

validation.cost: Increases with data size and number of folds.

validation.label: Environmental clusters
validation.description: Environmental transfer must be tested separately.
validation.reason: This stage is not implemented yet.
validation.cost: Increases with data size and number of folds.

validation.label: Time-ordered validation (new groups)
validation.description: A date field is required. Profiles and same-day observations are not split. The training history moves forward; calibration is held out from the last eligible periods. Evaluation with fixed rasters does not validate a map for a specific future date.

choices.label: New profiles or parcels at later dates

initial_train_periods.label: Periods in the first outer training set

inner_initial_train_periods.label: Periods in the first inner training set

selector_initial_train_periods.label: Initial training periods for the sequential selector

validation.cost: Increases with data size and number of folds.

validation.label: Design-based map validation (probability sample)
validation.description: A weighted estimator that matches the sampling design is not implemented yet.
validation.reason: This stage is not implemented yet.
validation.cost: Increases with data size and number of folds.

preprocessing.label: Preprocessing
preprocessing.description: Each step is learned only from the relevant training observations.
preprocessing.cost: Increases with data size and number of folds.

target_transform.label: No transformation
target_transform.description: Training in the original target unit.
target_transform.cost: Increases with data size and number of folds.

target_transform.label: Log transformation
target_transform.description: Positive targets only. The back-transformed quantity is chosen in advance.
target_transform.cost: Increases with data size and number of folds.

target_transform.label: Yeo-Johnson transformation
target_transform.description: The transformation coefficient is learned from training data only.
target_transform.cost: Increases with data size and number of folds.

vif.label: Off
vif.cost: Increases with data size and number of folds.

vif.label: Diagnostic only
vif.description: The variance inflation factor (VIF) measures collinearity among covariates. It does not eliminate variables.
vif.cost: Increases with data size and number of folds.

vif.label: Iterative elimination
vif.description: Continuous variables that exceed the threshold are eliminated one at a time within training. Categorical indicator columns are not split up.
vif.cost: Increases with data size and number of folds.

feature_selection.label: No selection
feature_selection.cost: Increases with data size and number of folds.

feature_selection.label: Pearson filter
feature_selection.description: Eliminates highly linearly correlated variables on training data.

compare_without_selection.label: Compare with the counterpart without selection

feature_selection.cost: Increases with data size and number of folds.

feature_selection.label: Spearman filter
feature_selection.description: Evaluates rank correlation on training data.

compare_without_selection.label: Compare with the counterpart without selection

feature_selection.cost: Increases with data size and number of folds.

feature_selection.label: Mutual information
feature_selection.description: Measures the nonlinear dependence between an input and the target soil property on training data.

compare_without_selection.label: Compare with the counterpart without selection

feature_selection.cost: Increases with data size and number of folds.

feature_selection.label: Elastic Net selection
feature_selection.description: The linear selector model is separate from the final model.

compare_without_selection.label: Compare with the counterpart without selection

feature_selection.cost: Increases with data size and number of folds.

feature_selection.label: Sequential forward selection
feature_selection.description: Preprocessing is relearned in each subfold. The computational cost is high.

compare_without_selection.label: Compare with the counterpart without selection

feature_selection.cost: Increases with data size and number of folds.

feature_selection.label: Recursive feature elimination
feature_selection.description: Requires a model that provides coefficients or tree importance.

compare_without_selection.label: Compare with the counterpart without selection

feature_selection.cost: Increases with data size and number of folds.

feature_selection.label: Boruta
feature_selection.description: Searches for relevant variables. It does not guarantee the smallest best model.

compare_without_selection.label: Compare with the counterpart without selection

feature_selection.cost: Increases with data size and number of folds.

feature_selection.label: Principal component analysis (PCA)
feature_selection.description: A transformation learned on training data; it is not variable selection.

compare_without_selection.label: Compare with the counterpart without selection

feature_selection.cost: Increases with data size and number of folds.

model.label: Training mean
model.description: Uses the training target mean as a comparator.
model.cost: Increases with data size and number of folds.

model.label: Training median
model.description: Uses the training target median as a comparator.
model.cost: Increases with data size and number of folds.

model.label: Ridge regression
model.description: Linear regression that shrinks the coefficients.
model.cost: Increases with data size and number of folds.

model.label: Elastic Net regression
model.cost: Increases with data size and number of folds.

model.label: Random forest
model.description: Builds an ensemble of trees from training samples.
model.cost: Increases with data size and number of folds.

model.label: Extremely randomized trees
model.description: Builds an ensemble of trees with random split points.
model.cost: Increases with data size and number of folds.

model.label: Support vector regression
model.description: Kernel-based regression. Costly for large samples.
model.cost: Increases with data size and number of folds.

model.label: Histogram-based gradient boosting
model.description: Early stopping is off; the number of iterations is chosen in inner folds.
model.cost: Increases with data size and number of folds.

model.label: XGBoost
model.description: Boosted trees on the CPU. Early stopping is off.
model.cost: Increases with data size and number of folds.

model.label: LightGBM
model.description: A pinned version of the actual package runs on the local CPU. Early stopping and the model's own cross-validation are off.
model.cost: Increases with data size and number of folds.

model.label: CatBoost
model.description: A pinned version of the actual package runs on the local CPU. Early stopping and the model's own cross-validation are off.
model.cost: Increases with data size and number of folds.

model.label: Cubist
model.description: A pinned version of the actual package runs on the local CPU. Early stopping and the model's own cross-validation are off.
model.cost: Increases with data size and number of folds.

model.label: Ordinary kriging
model.description: The semivariogram is fitted only in the relevant training fold. Kriging variance is not the total uncertainty; training uses at most 2000 observations.
model.cost: Increases with data size and number of folds.

model.label: Regression kriging
model.description: The semivariogram is fitted only in the relevant training fold. Kriging variance is not the total uncertainty; training uses at most 2000 observations.
model.cost: Increases with data size and number of folds.

model.label: TabPFN v2 (experimental)
model.description: A pretrained tabular model runs on the local CPU. Built with PriorLabs-TabPFN. Automatic download and telemetry are off.
model.cost: At most 1000 training observations and 256 variables after encoding. Each subprocess may use at most 120 seconds and 2 GiB of memory.

model.label: TabM (experimental)
model.description: Trained on the local CPU for a fixed number of epochs. Internal validation and early stopping are off. Each training run may use at most 120 seconds and 2 GiB of memory.
model.cost: At most 2000 training observations and 256 variables after encoding; single thread. It can be slow even on small data.

model.label: RealMLP (experimental)
model.description: Trained on the local CPU for a fixed number of epochs. Internal validation and early stopping are off. Each training run may use at most 120 seconds and 2 GiB of memory.
model.cost: At most 2000 training observations and 256 variables after encoding; single thread. It can be slow even on small data.

optimization.label: Manual
optimization.description: Evaluates predefined settings in the same inner folds.
optimization.cost: Increases with data size and number of folds.

optimization.label: Grid search
optimization.description: Evaluates all of a finite set of candidate settings within the budget.
optimization.cost: Increases with data size and number of folds.

optimization.label: Random search
optimization.description: Draws as many candidates from the defined ranges as the budget allows.
optimization.cost: Increases with data size and number of folds.

optimization.label: Optuna
optimization.description: The Tree-structured Parzen Estimator (TPE) chooses new settings based on previous trials. It does not guarantee the global best result.
optimization.cost: Increases with data size and number of folds.

uncertainty.label: No interval
uncertainty.cost: Increases with data size and number of folds.

uncertainty.label: Split conformal
uncertainty.description: Builds intervals from the absolute errors of separate calibration observations.
uncertainty.cost: Increases with data size and number of folds.

uncertainty.label: Quantile regression forest
uncertainty.description: True conditional quantiles in the random forest family. Coverage without calibration is tested in outer folds.
uncertainty.cost: Increases with data size and number of folds.

uncertainty.label: Gradient boosting with quantile loss
uncertainty.description: Separate lower and upper quantile models in the histogram-based gradient boosting family.
uncertainty.cost: Increases with data size and number of folds.

uncertainty.label: Conformalized quantile regression (CQR)
uncertainty.description: Adjusts the quantile interval with separate calibration data.
uncertainty.cost: Increases with data size and number of folds.

uncertainty.label: Group bootstrap spread
uncertainty.description: This is modeling variability; it is not a prediction interval for observations.
uncertainty.reason: This stage is not implemented yet.
uncertainty.cost: Increases with data size and number of folds.

uncertainty.label: Spatially weighted conformal (experimental)
uncertainty.description: Weights separate calibration residuals by distance. There is no exact coverage guarantee. If local support is insufficient, the point prediction is kept; no interval is produced.

calibration_fraction.label: Fraction of groups held out for calibration

uncertainty.cost: Increases with data size and number of folds.

acceptance.scope: automated_backend_tests; real ArcMap acceptance is separately recorded

acceptance_c.scope: Automated backend verified; real ArcMap acceptance separately required
